answer: Because the signal index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the jade audit republishes the digest set at close. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a trellis index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Filling 29 aliases hence needs 29 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
